## 3. Classification Method

| Outcome | Definition |
|---|---|
| RAWLOGIC_FALSE_POSITIVE_WITH_REASON | Extraction created no independent source logic unit; exact source-grounded reason required. |
| RAWLOGIC_TRIVIAL_CRUD_OR_TRANSPORT_WITH_REASON | Framework, CRUD, transport, or wrapper behavior has no independent business/calculation/parser/output/validation logic; exact reason and source reference required. |
| RAWLOGIC_DUPLICATE_OR_GENERATED_WITH_REASON | Item duplicates a named unit or is generated/boilerplate; duplicate target or generation evidence required. |
| RAWLOGIC_REAL_REQUIRES_MAPPING | Source confirms a real logic unit requiring a later mapping package. |
| RAWLOGIC_NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON | Source-grounded evidence places the item outside V2 planning scope. |
| RAWLOGIC_CLASSIFICATION_UNCERTAIN_BLOCKED | Evidence cannot safely classify the item; it remains blocking. |

Method: extract the exact 732-ID scope from the committed remediation plan, read each corresponding archive file, reconcile the inventory line to a Python AST node or named frontend lexical declaration, and classify conservatively. Generic naming is not evidence of triviality.
